items.title: There was a moment last night where Sengun got stuck on an island at the elbow. Last year he just would have ate clock and forced something, but now he had Fred who demanded the ball on the wing so he could reset and post feed KD.
items.author: Nathan Fogg
items.body_excerpt:
There was a moment last night where Sengun got stuck on an island at the elbow. Last year he just would have ate clock and forced something, but now he had Fred who demanded the ball on the wing so he could reset and post feed KD. 

Having a point guard is good!

quote.author: Rob Dover
quote.text:
They also can actually throw it into the post properly now*! 

*Well, Fred can. The rest of them were still hopeless at it.

items.title: Rockets play out of the same alignment. FVV hits Jabari Smith, this time he cuts through. Swing to Sengun and FVV off a stagger on the right side. You end up getting KD a pretty good look just by making the defense move.
items.author: Steve Jones
items.body_excerpt: Rockets play out of the same alignment. FVV hits Jabari Smith, this time he cuts through. Swing to Sengun and FVV off a stagger on the right side. You end up getting KD a pretty good look just by making the defense move.

items.title: You can see where the Rockets are trying to add more movement offensively. Notice the cutting. Playing out of Pistol like action, FVV hits KD and off a flare from Sengun. Jabari cuts from the wing to clear space, FVV drives and Amen Thompson cuts from the corner.
